value.zh: 本養外家何氏。
value.en: He had been raised under the He surname on his mother’s side.
value.literal: Originally he was raised by his maternal He family.

value.zh: 後復姓王。
value.en: He later resumed the surname Wang.
value.literal: Later he restored the surname Wang.

value.zh: 隨杜濩、樸胡詣洛陽，假校尉，從曹公征漢中，因降先主，拜牙門將、裨將軍。
value.en: He went to Luoyang with Du Hu and Pu Hu as acting colonel, followed Cao Cao into Hanzhong, then defected to Liu Bei and became colonel of the standard and supporting general.
value.literal: He followed Du Hu and Pu Hu to Luoyang; he was appointed acting Colonel; he followed Duke Cao on campaign against Hanzhong; therefore he surrendered to the First Sovereign and was appointed Colonel of the Standard and General Who Supports Might.

value.zh: 建興六年，屬參軍馬謖先鋒。
value.en: In 228 he served under army adviser Ma Su as vanguard.
value.literal: In the sixth year of Jianxing [228], he was attached to Army Adviser Ma Su's vanguard.

value.zh: 謖捨水上山，舉措煩擾，平連規諫謖，謖不能用，大敗於街亭。
value.en: Ma Su forsook the river for the heights and bungled deployment; Wang Ping argued repeatedly but was ignored, and they were routed at Jieting.
value.literal: Su abandoned the water and went up the mountain; his measures were vexing and disturbed; Ping repeatedly remonstrated with Su; Su could not employ [his advice]; there was great defeat at Jieting.

value.zh: 眾盡星散，惟平所領千人鳴鼓自持，魏將張郃疑其伏兵，不往逼也。
value.en: The army fled in panic while Wang Ping’s thousand men beat drums and held line until Zhang He feared an ambush and halted.
value.literal: The host all scattered like stars; only the thousand led by Ping beat drums and held formation; Wei general Zhang He suspected ambush and did not press forward.

value.zh: 於是平徐徐收合諸營遺迸，率將士而還。
value.en: Wang Ping slowly regrouped the broken camps and marched the survivors home.
value.literal: Thereupon Ping slowly gathered the scattered remnants of the various camps and led officers and troops back.

value.zh: 丞相亮既誅馬謖及將軍張休、李盛，奪將軍黃襲等兵。
value.en: Zhuge Liang executed Ma Su, Zhang Xiu, and Li Sheng and cashiered Huang Xi’s command.
value.literal: After Chancellor Liang executed Ma Su as well as Generals Zhang Xiu and Li Sheng, he stripped Generals Huang Xi and others of their troops.

value.zh: 平特見崇顯，加拜參軍，統五部兼當營事，進位討寇將軍，封亭侯。
value.en: Wang Ping alone was rewarded with army adviser rank, command of five tribal divisions, camp duties, promotion to general who punishes rebels, and a village marquisate.
value.literal: Ping alone was specially honored and elevated; he was additionally appointed army adviser, commanding five divisions while concurrently handling camp affairs; he advanced in rank to General Who Punishes Rebels and was enfeoffed as village marquis.

value.zh: 九年，亮圍祁山，平別守南圍。
value.en: In 231, during the Qishan siege, Wang Ping held the southern perimeter.
value.literal: In the ninth year [231], Liang besieged Qishan; Ping separately guarded the southern enclosure.

value.zh: 魏大將軍司馬宣王攻亮，張郃攻平，平堅守不動，郃不能克。
value.en: While Sima Yi struck Zhuge Liang, Zhang He assaulted Wang Ping’s sector but could not break his defense.
value.literal: Wei Grand General Sima Yi attacked Liang; Zhang He attacked Ping; Ping defended firmly without moving; He could not overcome him.

value.zh: 蔣琬字公琰，零陵湘鄉人也。
value.en: Jiang Wan, courtesy name Gongyan, came from Xiangxiang in Lingling Commandery.
value.literal: Jiang Wan, courtesy name Gongyan, was a native of Xiangxiang in Lingling.

value.zh: 弱冠與外弟泉陵劉敏懼知名。
value.en: While still young he won local fame alongside his cousin Liu Min of Quanling.
value.literal: While still young he won local fame alongside his cousin Liu Min of Quanling.

value.zh: 琬以州書佐隨先主入蜀，除廣都長。
value.en: He entered Shu as a provincial clerk under Liu Bei and was named magistrate of Guangdu.
value.literal: Wan served as a provincial clerk and followed the Vanguard Lord into Shu; he was appointed magistrate of Guangdu.

value.zh: 先主嘗因遊觀奄至廣都，見琬眾事不理，時又沉醉，先主大怒，將加罪戮。
value.en: Liu Bei came to Guangdu on a tour, found Jiang Wan drunk and neglecting his duties, and was ready to execute him.
value.literal: The Vanguard Lord once on a pleasure outing suddenly arrived at Guangdu and saw Wan leaving official business unattended and at the time also deeply drunk; the Vanguard Lord was greatly angry and was about to impose punishment and execution.

value.zh: 軍師將軍諸葛亮請曰：「蔣琬，社稷之器，非百里之才也。
value.en: Zhuge Liang intervened: "Jiang Wan is material for the empire, not a petty county magistrate.
value.literal: Army commander Zhuge Liang pleaded, saying, "Jiang Wan is vessel of the altars of soil and grain—not talent for a hundred li.

value.zh: 其為政以安民為本，不以修飾為先，願主公重加察之。」
value.en: He rules by putting the people at ease, not by polished appearances—please look again, my lord."
value.literal: His governing takes pacifying the people as root, not ornament as first; wish the lord examine him again carefully."

value.zh: 先主雅敬亮，乃不加罪，倉卒但免官而已。
value.en: Liu Bei yielded to Zhuge Liang and spared him—stripping him of office alone.
value.literal: The Vanguard Lord always respected Liang and therefore did not add punishment; in haste he only dismissed from office.

value.zh: 琬見推之後，夜夢有—牛頭在門前，流血滂沱，意甚惡之，呼問占夢趙直。
value.en: After his promotion Jiang Wan dreamed of a bloody ox head at his gate and consulted Zhao Zhi about it.
value.literal: After Wan was promoted, he dreamed at night of an ox head before the gate, bleeding profusely—his intent felt very ill; he called to ask dream-diviner Zhao Zhi.

value.zh: 直曰：「夫見血者，事分明也。
value.en: Zhi said, "Seeing blood means affairs are clear-cut.
value.literal: Zhi said, "Seeing blood means affairs are clear-cut.

value.zh: 牛角及鼻，『公』字之象，君位必當至公，大吉之征也。」
value.en: Horns and snout sketch the word ‘duke’—you are destined for high, impartial office; most auspicious."
value.literal: Ox horn and nose are images of the character ‘public’; your position must reach utmost fairness—a greatly auspicious sign."

value.zh: 頃之，為什邡令。
value.en: Soon he was appointed magistrate of Shifang.
value.literal: Shortly thereafter he became magistrate of Shifang.

value.zh: 先主為漢中王，琬人為尚書郎。
value.en: When Liu Bei took the title King of Hanzhong, Jiang Wan became a secretary in the imperial secretariat.
value.literal: When the Vanguard Lord became King of Hanzhong, Wan entered as gentleman of the Masters of Writing.

value.zh: 延熙七年，魏軍次於興勢，假禕節，率眾往御之。
value.en: In Yanxi 7 (244), when Wei halted at Xingshi, Fei Yi took the imperial baton and marched to meet them.
value.literal: In Yanxi's seventh year Wei troops halted at Xingshi; Yi was lent credentials and led the host to oppose them.

value.zh: 光祿大夫來敏至禕許別，求共圍棋。
value.en: Grand Mentor Lai Min visited Fei Yi before departure and challenged him to a game of weiqi.
value.literal: Minister Laimin came to Yi's quarters to bid farewell and requested to play weiqi together.

value.zh: 於時羽檄交馳，人馬擐甲，嚴駕已訖。
value.en: Feather reports flew while troops stood harnessed and armed.
value.literal: At that time urgent bulletins flew crisscross; men and horses donned armor—strict readiness was already finished.

value.zh: 禕與敏留意對戲，色無厭倦。
value.en: Fei Yi gave the board his full attention without betraying anxiety.
value.literal: Yi and Min attended closely to the match—his expression showed no disgust or weariness.

value.zh: 敏曰：「向聊觀試君耳!君信可人，必能辦賊者也。」
value.en: Lai Min said: "I only tested you—you have the steel nerves needed against the enemy."
value.literal: Min said, "Just now I idly tested you! You truly are the right man—you surely can manage the bandits."

value.zh: 禕至，敵遂退，封成鄉侯。
value.en: Fei Yi reached the front and the Wei army withdrew; he received the village marquisate of Cheng.
value.literal: When Yi arrived, the enemy then withdrew; he was enfeoffed marquis of Cheng Village.

value.zh: 〈殷基通语曰：司马懿诛曹爽，祎设甲乙论平其是非。
value.en: < Yin Ji records that after Sima Yi killed Cao Shuang, Fei Yi wrote an A-side/B-side essay debating the deed.
value.literal: < Yin Ji's Comprehensive Tales records: When Sima Yi executed Cao Shuang, Yi drafted an A–B debate weighing their right and wrong.

value.zh: 甲以为曹爽兄弟凡品庸人，苟以宗子枝属，得蒙顾命之任，而骄奢僭逸，交非其人，私树朋党，谋以乱国。
value.en: Side A: Cao Shuang’s faction were mediocre men lifted only by blood ties; they wasted power on favorites until treason loomed.
value.literal: Side A held that Cao Shuang and his brothers were mediocre rustics—only because they were imperial kin did they receive testament authority—yet arrogance, luxury, and excess led them to trust unworthy men, build private factions, and plot to disorder the state.

value.zh: 懿奋诛讨，一朝殄尽，此所以称其任，副士民之望也。
value.en: Sima Yi struck decisively and cleared them in a day—matching duty and popular expectation.
value.literal: Yi rose to punish them—in one morning they were wiped out—thereby fulfilling his charge and answering scholar-officials' hopes.

value.zh: 乙以为懿感曹仲付己不一，岂爽与相干？
value.en: Side B: Sima Yi nursed private resentment—Cao Shuang was not the sole culprit.
value.literal: Side B held that Yi resented Cao Shuang for inconsistent trust—how could Shuang alone cause trouble?

value.zh: 事势不专，以此阴成疵瑕。
value.en: Shared authority let grudges fester unseen.
value.literal: Power was not concentrated—thereby he secretly bred faults.

value.zh: 初无忠告侃尔之训，一朝屠戮，攙其不意，岂大人经国笃本之事乎！
value.en: He offered no warning, then slaughtered them overnight—hardly the steady hand of a chief minister.
value.literal: From the first there was no earnest loyal counsel—yet in one dawn they slaughtered—catching them unaware—is that how great men anchor the state?

value.zh: 若爽信有谋主之心，大逆已构，而发兵之日，更以芳委爽兄弟。
value.en: If treason were real, why did he leave the emperor in Cao Shuang’s hands when mobilizing?
value.literal: If Shuang truly harbored treason, great rebellion already framed—yet when troops marched he still entrusted Cao Fang to Shuang's brothers.

value.zh: 懿父子从后闭门举兵，蹙而向芳，必无悉宁，忠臣为君深虑之谓乎？
value.en: The Simas barred the palace and turned arms on the sovereign—was that loyal foresight?
value.literal: Yi and his son closed the gates behind and raised troops—pressing toward Fang—could loyal ministers deeply counsel thus?

value.zh: 以此推之，爽无大恶明矣。
value.en: On this reading Cao Shuang’s guilt was hardly proven.
value.literal: By this reasoning Shuang had no great evil—it is clear.

value.zh: 若懿以爽奢僭，废之刑之可也，灭其尺口，被以不义，绝子丹血食，及何晏子魏之亲甥，亦与同戮，为僭滥不当矣。〉
value.en: Executing the entire clan and collateral kin—including He Yan—went beyond justice.>
value.literal: If Yi thought Shuang extravagant and presumptuous—depose or punish him—acceptable; but extinguishing his whole household, branding him unjust, cutting off Dan's sacrifices—and even executing He Yan, the emperor's kin—was cruel excess.>

value.zh: 琬固讓州職，禕復領益州刺史。
value.en: Jiang Wan declined the governorship of Yi; Fei Yi reassumed it.
value.literal: Wan firmly yielded the provincial post; Yi again took Yi Province inspector.

value.zh: 禕當國功名，略與琬比。
value.en: As steward of Shu his stature rivaled Jiang Wan’s.
value.literal: Yi holding state—merit and fame roughly matched Wan.

value.zh: 禕别傳曰：禕雅性谦素，家不积财。
value.en: It adds that Fei Yi lived modestly and kept little treasure.
value.literal: The supplemental biography says: Yi was by nature humble and plain—his household did not hoard wealth.

value.zh: 兒子皆令布衣素食，出入不从车骑，无异凡人。
value.en: He made his sons dress like commoners and travel without escort.
value.literal: His sons were ordered plain cloth and vegetarian diet; going out they did not follow chariots and riders—no difference from common folk.

value.zh: 十一年，出住漢中，自琬及禕，雖自身在外，慶賞刑威，皆遙先咨斷然，後乃行。
value.en: In Yanxi 11 (248) he moved to Hanzhong; even away from Chengdu he and Jiang Wan still settled rewards and punishments by courier before execution.
value.literal: In the eleventh year he went out to garrison Hanzhong—from Wan and Yi onward, though themselves outside, rewards, punishments, and awe were all first consulted and decided from afar, then carried out.

value.zh: 其推任如此。
value.en: The court trusted them that completely.
value.literal: Such was the trust placed in them.

value.zh: 後十四年夏，還成都，成都望氣者雲都邑無宰相位，故冬復比屯漢壽。
value.en: Soothsayers claimed Chengdu held no seat for a chief minister, so he wintered again at Hanshou.
value.literal: Later in the fourteenth year's summer he returned to Chengdu—Chengdu aura-readers said the capital lacked a minister's seat—therefore in winter he again camped north at Hanshou.

value.zh: 諸葛恪
value.en: Zhuge Ke
value.literal: Zhuge Ke.

value.zh: 赤烏中，魏司馬宣王謀欲攻恪。
value.en: In the Chiwu years Sima Yi of Wei laid plans to crush Zhuge Ke.
value.literal: During the Chiwu reign-period, Sima Yi (King Xuan of Wei) planned an offensive against Ke.

value.zh: 權方發兵應之，望氣者以為不利，於是徒恪屯於柴桑。
value.en: Wu was mobilizing to meet the threat when court diviners called the stars hostile, so Ke’s corps was redeployed to Chaisang.
value.literal: Sun Quan was on the point of raising troops to counter him when specialists in reading vapors pronounced the omens ill; thereupon Ke’s command was shifted to garrison Chaisang.

value.zh: 與丞相陸遜書曰：
value.en: He sent Chancellor Lu Xun a letter that ran:
value.literal: He wrote to Chancellor Lu Xun, saying:

value.zh: 夫天無二日，土無二王，王者不務兼併天下而欲垂祚後世，古今未之有也。
value.en: Two suns cannot share the sky; two kings cannot share the soil—no emperor ever secured his line without conquering all beneath it.
value.literal: Heaven admits no second sun; earth bears no second king—never in antiquity or today has a true king aimed to pass down fortune without striving to swallow the realm.

value.zh: 昔戰國之時，諸候自恃兵強地廣，互有救援，謂此足以傳世，人莫能危。
value.en: Warring States princes trusted mutual rescue and vast domains to live forever safe.
value.literal: In the Warring States age each lord trusted his strong armies and broad lands, lent aid across borders, deemed such enough to preserve his line forever beyond peril.

value.zh: 恣情從懷，憚於勞苦，使秦漸得自大，遂以並之，此既然矣。
value.en: They lounged while Qin grew—then swallowed them whole.
value.literal: They indulged whim and shrank from toil until Qin-by degrees grew paramount and annexed them—so it proved.

value.zh: 近者劉景昇在荊州，有眾十萬，財谷如山。
value.en: Liu Biao once held Jingzhou—hosts in six figures, granaries like mountains.
value.literal: Recently Liu Jingsheng held Jingzhou with a hundred thousand men and grain piled like hills.

value.zh: 不及曹操尚微，與之力競，坐觀其強大，吞滅諸袁，北方都定之後，操率三十萬眾來向荊州，當時雖有吞智者，不能復為畫計，於是景升兒子，交臂請降，遂為囚虜。
value.en: He refused to strike Cao while Cao was small, watched him crush the Yuans and pacify the north—then three hundred thousand Wei troops rolled south; even clever advisers could plot nothing; Biao’s sons surrendered shackled.
value.literal: Before Cao Cao was still weak he declined to wrestle him, sat watching him swell, swallow the Yuans, settle the north—then Cao led three hundred thousand south toward Jingzhou; though wise men remained, none could sketch further counsel; Jingsheng’s sons folded arms and sued for surrender, ending prisoners.

value.zh: 凡敵國欲相吞，即仇雠欲相除也，有仇而長之，禍不在己，則在後人，不可不為遠慮也。
value.en: States that would eat each other are feuds that must be killed—feed your foe and your heirs pay.
value.literal: Whenever rival states mean to devour each other it is as mortal foes meaning to erase each other—if you nurse an enemy you grow it; the calamity falls not on you then on those after—long sight cannot be neglected.

value.zh: 昔伍子胥曰：『越十年生聚，十年教訓，二十年之外，吳其為沼乎！』
value.en: Wu Zixu warned: “Ten years Yue breeds men, ten years schools them—twenty years on, Wu becomes swamp!”
value.literal: Wu Zixu said of old: “Yue will breed men ten years and train them ten years—twenty years hence Wu shall be marsh!”

value.zh: 夫差自恃強大，聞此邈然，是以誅子胥而無備越之心，至於臨敗悔之，豈有及乎？
value.en: Fucha trusted strength, sneered, slew Zixu, ignored Yue—too late he repented at the water’s edge.
value.literal: Fucha trusted his might, heard this with lofty dismissiveness—therefore he executed Zixu and never prepared against Yue; only when ruin closed in did he repent—could that avail?

value.zh: 越小於吳，尚為吳禍，況其強大者邪？
value.en: Lesser Yue ruined Wu—what of a stronger foe?
value.literal: Yue was smaller than Wu yet became Wu’s scourge—how much more a greater power?

value.zh: 昔秦但得關西耳，尚以併吞六國，今賊皆得秦趙、韓、魏、燕齊九州之地，地悉戎馬之鄉，士林之藪。
value.en: Classic Qin held only the western march yet devoured six states; Wei now owns Guanzhong and the Zhao-Han-Wei-Yan-Qi heartland—nine provinces of cavaliers and lettered men.
value.literal: Antiquity’s Qin possessed only the ground west of the passes yet swallowed the six kingdoms; today’s rebels hold Guanzhong and the old domains of Zhao, Han, Wei, Yan, and Qi—the nine heartland provinces where every vale breeds chargers and every dell hides scholars.

value.zh: 今以魏比古之秦，土地數倍；
value.en: Wei beside classic Qin spans several times the ground.
value.literal: Compare Wei to antique Qin—their territory multiples several fold.

value.zh: 以吳與蜀比古穴國，不能半之。
value.en: Wu and Shu together are not half that footprint.
value.literal: Compare Wu and Shu to ancient cave-minnow states—they do not reach half.

value.zh: 然所以能敵之，但以操時兵眾於今適盡，而後生者未悉長大，正是賊衰少未盛之時。
value.en: We endure because Cao’s cohort died off and boys still train—the enemy trough before the crest.
value.literal: Yet we can oppose them only because Cao Cao’s veterans are largely spent while replacements have not yet grown—this is precisely the foe’s thinning hour before his zenith.

value.zh: 加司馬懿先誅王淩，續自隕斃，其子幼弱，而專彼大任，雖有智計之士，未得施用。
value.en: Sima Yi slew Wang Ling then died; weak sons hold supreme command—brains stay bottled.
value.literal: Add that Sima Yi first executed Wang Ling then himself perished; his sons are young yet clutch supreme command—though strategists exist they cannot be employed.

value.zh: 當今伐之，是其厄會。
value.en: Strike now and you hit the hinge moment.
value.literal: To strike now is to catch their crisis.

value.zh: 聖人急於趨時，誠謂今日。
value.en: The sage races time—I say that hour is today.
value.literal: Sages hurry to ride the moment—I declare today that hour.

value.zh: 若順眾人之情，懷偷安之計，以為長江之險可以傳世；
value.en: Follow the crowd, cling to false peace, trust the Long River as eternal shield—
value.literal: If we follow the multitude’s mood and hug a policy of stolen ease, reckoning the Yangzi’s barrier enough to pass down generations —

value.zh: 不論魏之終始，而以今日遂輕其後。
value.en: —ignore Wei’s arc yet shrug at tomorrow—
value.literal: without weighing Wei’s beginning and end yet lightly dismissing what follows today —

value.zh: 此吾所以長歎息者也。
value.en: that is why I groan aloud.
value.literal: that is why I sigh long.

value.zh: 自本以來，務在產育，今者賊民歲月繁滋，但以尚小，未可得用耳。
value.en: Since dynastic founding we bred people; Wei’s peasants swell each year—they are young but not yet spear fodder.
value.literal: From our founders day we have urged breeding population; now enemy folk multiply yearly—they are still young and not yet usable.

value.zh: 若復十數年後，其眾必倍於今，而國家勁兵之地，皆已空盡，唯有此見眾可以定事。
value.en: Another decade doubles their ranks while our crack districts hollow—only today’s soldiers can decide it.
value.literal: Wait another dozen years and their numbers must double today’s while our elite regions already stand emptied—only these present troops can settle the matter.

value.zh: 若不早用之，端坐使老，復十數年，略當損半，而見子弟數不足言。
value.en: Idle them till old age and ten years cuts our hosts in half while heirs thin to nothing.
value.literal: If we do not use them early but sit until they age, another decade will roughly halve them while our sons barely merit mention.

value.zh: 若賊眾一倍，而我兵損半，雖復使伊、管圖之，未可如何。
value.en: Double them and halve us—even Yi Yin and Guan Zhong could not save us.
value.literal: If enemy strength doubles while ours halves, though Yi Yin and Guan Zhong plotted, nothing could be done.

value.zh: 今不達遠慮者，必以此言為迂。
value.en: Short thinkers will call this preachy.
value.literal: Men lacking far sight must deem such words pedantic.

value.zh: 夫禍難未至而豫憂慮，此固眾人之所迂也。
value.en: Worry before disaster looks foolish—crowds always sneer.
value.literal: Calamity not yet arrived yet anxiety beforehand—this is what common minds dismiss as pedantic.

value.zh: 及於難至，然後頓顙，雖有智者，又不能圖。
value.en: Disaster lands and they beat their brows—too late for even wise heads.
value.literal: When disaster strikes they knock foreheads in vain—though wise men remain, nothing can be plotted.

value.zh: 此乃古今所病，非獨一時。
value.en: That folly spans every age—not ours alone.
value.literal: This sickness runs through ages—not one moment alone.

value.zh: 昔吳始以伍員為迂，故難至而不可救。
value.en: Wu once mocked Wu Zixu as alarmist—when doom came there was no remedy.
value.literal: Long ago Wu first deemed Wu Yuan pedantic—hence when calamity arrived they could not be saved.

value.zh: 劉景升不能慮十年之後，故無以治其子孫。
value.en: Liu Biao never looked past the decade—so he left no shelter for his heirs.
value.literal: Liu Jingsheng could not plan ten years ahead—therefore he had no way to govern his sons and grandsons.

value.zh: 今恪無具臣之才，而受大吳蕭、霍之任，智與眾同思不經遠，若不及今日為國斥境，俯仰年老，而仇敵更強。
value.en: I lack common bureaucratic polish yet carry a Xiao-Huo burden for Wu; my wit is ordinary—if I fail to widen our borders now, old age will creep in while enemies swell.
value.literal: Now Ke lacks the talent of a mere competent minister yet bears Great Wu’s charge such as fell to Xiao He and Huo Guang; his wisdom matches the crowd’s and his thought does not reach far—if he does not today for the state push the frontier, in the blink of an eye he will age while foes grow stronger.

value.zh: 欲刎頸謝責，寧有補邪？
value.en: Would slitting my throat then undo the stain?
value.literal: Wishing then to cut one’s throat and apologize for fault—would that avail?

value.zh: 今聞眾人或以百姓尚貧，欲務閒息，此不右其慮其大危而其小勤者也。
value.en: Some plead poverty and urge repose—they fret over small fatigue while ignoring existential peril.
value.literal: Now I hear some argue that because the common people remain poor they wish to pursue ease and rest—this fails to weigh supreme peril against petty hardship.

value.zh: 昔漢祖幸已自有三秦之地，何不閉關守險以自娛樂，空出攻楚，身被創痍，介冑生蟣蝨，將士厭困苦，豈甘鋒刃而忘安寧哉？
value.en: Gaozu held Guanzhong—why not bolt Hangu and feast? He chose war: wounds, lice in his armor, troops pushed past endurance—not because they loved steel over peace.
value.literal: Of old the Han Founding Emperor already possessed the Three Qins—why did he not bar the passes and guard the defiles for private pleasure, instead marching out empty-handed against Chu, his body scarred, lice breeding in helm and mail, officers sick of misery—did they relish naked blades and forget quiet?

value.zh: 慮於長久不得兩存者耳！
value.en: They knew two dragons cannot share one pool.
value.literal: They reckoned that long-term survival allowed no two powers side by side!

value.zh: 每覽荊邯說公孫述以進取之圖，近風家叔父表陳與賊爭競之計，未嘗不喟然歎息也。
value.en: Each time I read Jing Han’s brief to Gongsun Shu or my uncle’s essay on tackling Wei, I groan with recognition.
value.literal: Whenever I read how Jing Han urged Gongsun Shu with plans of advance, or lately my uncle’s memorial laying out how to vie with the foe, never do I fail to sigh aloud.

value.zh: 夙夜反側，所慮如此，故聊疏愚言，以達二三君子之末。
value.en: These worries cost me sleep—so I sketch this crude plea for you few who judge.
value.literal: Night and day I toss with such cares—therefore I loosely set forth these blunt words to reach the ears of you gentlemen.

value.zh: 若一朝隕歿志畫不立，貴令來世知我所憂，可思於後。
value.en: If I die before the plan is laid, let posterity read my fear and learn.
value.literal: If one morning I fall dead before designs are fixed, may later generations know what gnawed me and ponder it after.

value.zh: 志第十三 天文一
value.en: Treatise Thirteen: Astronomy, Part One
value.literal: Treatise 13: Astronomy 1

value.zh: 黃初四年三月癸卯，月犯心大星。
value.en: the fourth year of Huangchu, third month, day guimao: the moon crossed the great star of Heart.
value.literal: Huangchu year 4, third month, day guimao: the moon encroached on the great star of Heart.

value.zh: 十二月丙子，月又犯心大星。
value.en: Twelfth month, day bingzi: the moon again crossed the great star of Heart.
value.literal: Twelfth month, day bingzi: the moon again encroached on the great star of Heart.

value.zh: 占曰：「心為天王，王者惡之。」
value.en: Prognostication reads: "Heart is the celestial king—rulers dread its violation."
value.literal: Prognostication says: "Heart is the celestial king—rulers dread it."

value.zh: 七年五月，文帝崩。
value.en: In the fifth month of year seven Emperor Wen died.
value.literal: In the fifth month of the seventh year, Emperor Wen died.

value.zh: 黃初四年六月甲申，太白晝見。
value.en: the fourth year of Huangchu, sixth month, day jiashen: Venus appeared in daylight.
value.literal: Huangchu year 4, sixth month, day jiashen: Great White was seen in daylight.

value.zh: 五年十一月辛卯，太白又晝見。
value.en: In the fifth year, on the xinmao day of the eleventh month, Venus again appeared in daylight.
value.literal: Year 5, eleventh month, day xinmao: Great White was again seen in daylight.

value.zh: 案劉向《五紀論》曰：「太白少陰，弱，不得專行，故以己未為界，不得經天而行。
value.en: Liu Xiang's Five Regulators Treatise explains: "Venus is lesser yin and weak, unable to travel alone; bounded by ji and wei it cannot cross the sky.
value.literal: Examining Liu Xiang's Five Regulators Treatise: "Great White is lesser yin, weak, and cannot travel alone; hence with ji-wei as its boundary it cannot cross heaven and travel.

value.zh: 經天則晝見，其占為兵，為喪，為不臣，為更王。
value.en: When it crosses the sky it appears by day, portending war, mourning, treason, and dynastic change.
value.literal: When it crosses heaven it is seen by day; its prognostication is war, mourning, disloyal ministers, and change of kings.

value.zh: 強國弱，小國強。」
value.en: Great powers weaken while lesser ones grow strong."
value.literal: Strong states weaken; small states strengthen."

value.zh: 是時，孫權受魏爵號，而稱兵距守。
value.en: Sun Quan had accepted Wei titles yet took up arms and held his ground.
value.literal: At that time Sun Quan had received Wei's enfeoffment and title, yet raised troops and held out in resistance.

value.zh: 七年五月，文帝崩。
value.en: In the fifth month of year seven Emperor Wen died.
value.literal: In the fifth month of the seventh year, Emperor Wen died.

value.zh: 八月，吳遂圍江夏，寇襄陽，魏江夏太守文聘固守得全。
value.en: In the eighth month Wu besieged Jiangxia and raided Xiangyang; Wei's Wen Pin, Administrator of Jiangxia, held the city intact.
value.literal: In the eighth month Wu then besieged Jiangxia and raided Xiangyang; Wei's Administrator of Jiangxia Wen Pin held firm and preserved the city.

value.zh: 大將軍司馬懿救襄陽，斬吳將張霸。
value.en: Grand General Sima Yi relieved Xiangyang and killed Wu's Zhang Ba.
value.literal: Grand General Sima Yi relieved Xiangyang and beheaded Wu's general Zhang Ba.

value.zh: 魏明帝太和四年十一月壬戌，太白犯歲星。
value.en: Wei Emperor Ming, Taihe 4, eleventh month, day renxu: Venus crossed Jupiter.
value.literal: Wei Emperor Ming, Taihe year 4, eleventh month, day renxu: Great White encroached on the Year Star.

value.zh: 占曰：「太白犯五星，有大兵；
value.en: Prognostication reads: "When Venus crosses a planet, major war erupts;
value.literal: Prognostication says: "When Great White encroaches on the five stars, there is great warfare;

value.zh: 犯列宿，為小兵。」
value.en: crossing a constellation lodge means lesser conflict."
value.literal: encroaching on listed lodges means small warfare."

value.zh: 五年三月，諸葛亮以大眾寇天水，遣大將軍司馬懿距退之。
value.en: Taihe 5, third month: Zhuge Liang attacked Tianshui with a large force; Grand General Sima Yi was dispatched and drove him back.
value.literal: Year 5, third month, Zhuge Liang with a great host raided Tianshui; Grand General Sima Yi was sent to repel and drive him back.

value.zh: 太和五年五月，熒惑犯房。
value.en: Taihe 5, fifth month: Mars crossed Encampment.
value.literal: Taihe year 5, fifth month: Sparkling Deluder encroached on Encampment.

value.zh: 占曰：「房四星，股肱臣將相位也。
value.en: Prognostication reads: "Encampment's four stars govern the ruler's chief ministers and the posts of general and chancellor.
value.literal: Prognostication says: "The four stars of Encampment are the limb-and-bone ministers and the rank of general and chancellor.

value.zh: 月五星犯守之，將相有憂。」
value.en: When the moon or planets cross or hold it, generals and chancellors face danger."
value.literal: When the moon and five planets encroach on or guard it, generals and chancellors have anxiety."

value.zh: 七月，車騎將軍張郃追諸葛亮，為其所害。
value.en: In the seventh month Chariots-and-Cavalry General Zhang He pursued Zhuge Liang and was slain.
value.literal: Seventh month, Chariots-and-Cavalry General Zhang He pursued Zhuge Liang and was killed by him.

value.zh: 十二月，太尉華歆薨。
value.en: In the twelfth month Grand Commandant Hua Xin died.
value.literal: Twelfth month, Grand Commandant Hua Xin died.

value.zh: 太和五年十一月乙酉，月犯軒轅大星。
value.en: Taihe 5, eleventh month, day yiyou: the moon crossed the great star of Chariot Pivot.
value.literal: Taihe year 5, eleventh month, day yiyou: the moon encroached on the great star of Chariot Pivot.

value.zh: 占曰：「女主憂。」
value.en: Prognostication reads: "The empress faces danger."
value.literal: Prognostication says: "The chief consort has anxiety."

value.zh: 十二月甲辰，月犯鎮星。
value.en: Twelfth month, day jiachen: the moon crossed Saturn.
value.literal: Twelfth month, day jiachen: the moon encroached on Quelling Star.

value.zh: 占曰：「女主當之。」
value.en: Prognostication reads: "The empress will suffer the blow."
value.literal: Prognostication says: "The chief consort will bear it."

value.zh: 六年三月乙亥，月又犯軒轅大星。
value.en: Taihe 6, third month, day yihai: the moon again crossed the great star of Chariot Pivot.
value.literal: Year 6, third month, day yihai: the moon again encroached on the great star of Chariot Pivot.

value.zh: 青龍二年十一月乙丑，月又犯鎮星。
value.en: Qinglong 2, eleventh month, day yichou: the moon again crossed Saturn.
value.literal: Qinglong year 2, eleventh month, day yichou: the moon again encroached on Quelling Star.

value.zh: 三年正月，太后郭氏崩。
value.en: Qinglong 3, first month: Empress Dowager Guo died.
value.literal: Year 3, first month, Empress Dowager Guo died.

value.zh: 明帝青龍二年二月己未，太白犯熒惑。
value.en: Emperor Ming, Qinglong 2, second month, day jiwei: Venus crossed Mars.
value.literal: Emperor Ming, Qinglong year 2, second month, day jiwei: Great White encroached on Sparkling Deluder.

value.zh: 占曰：「大兵起，有大戰。」
value.en: Prognostication reads: "Major war erupts; a great battle follows."
value.literal: Prognostication says: "Great warfare rises; there is a great battle."

value.zh: 是年四月，諸葛亮據渭南，吳亦起兵應之，魏東西奔命。
value.en: That year in the fourth month Zhuge Liang held the south Wei River; Wu mobilized in support, and Wei rushed troops east and west.
value.literal: That year, fourth month, Zhuge Liang held the south bank of the Wei River; Wu also raised troops in response, and Wei raced east and west to answer both.

value.zh: 九月，亮卒，軍退，將帥分爭，為魏所破。
value.en: In the ninth month Liang died; the army retreated, its commanders turned on one another, and Wei crushed them.
value.literal: Ninth month, Liang died; the army withdrew, commanders quarreled among themselves, and were defeated by Wei.

value.zh: 案占，太白所犯在南，南國敗，在北，北國敗，此宜在熒惑南也。
value.en: Per the texts, when Venus strikes a target in the south the southern state falls, in the north the northern state falls—and here Venus should have lain south of Mars.
value.literal: Examining prognostication: wherever Great White encroaches, if in the south the southern state is defeated, if in the north the northern state is defeated—here it should have been south of Sparkling Deluder.

value.zh: 青龍二年三月辛卯，月犯輿鬼。
value.en: Qinglong 2, third month, day xinmao: the moon crossed Carriage Ghost.
value.literal: Qinglong year 2, third month, day xinmao: the moon encroached on Carriage Ghost.

value.zh: 輿鬼主斬殺。
value.en: Carriage Ghost governs execution and slaughter.
value.literal: Carriage Ghost governs beheading and slaying.

value.zh: 占曰：「民多病，國有憂，又有大臣憂。」
value.en: Prognostication reads: "The people sicken widely; the state and its senior ministers face disaster."
value.literal: Prognostication says: "The people have much illness; the state has anxiety, and great ministers have anxiety too."

value.zh: 是年夏，大疫；
value.en: That summer a great plague struck;
value.literal: That year in summer, great pestilence;

value.zh: 冬，又大病，至三年春乃止。
value.en: in winter another wave of disease raged until it abated in the spring of year three.
value.literal: in winter, again great illness, until spring of year 3 it ceased.

value.zh: 正月，太后郭氏崩。
value.en: In the first month Empress Dowager Guo died.
value.literal: First month, Empress Dowager Guo died.

value.zh: 四年五月，司徒董昭薨。
value.en: Qinglong 4, fifth month: Minister of Works Dong Zhao died.
value.literal: Year 4, fifth month, Minister of Works Dong Zhao died.

value.zh: 青龍二年五月丁亥，太白晝見，積三十餘日。
value.en: Qinglong 2, fifth month, day dinghai: Venus appeared in daylight for more than thirty days.
value.literal: Qinglong year 2, fifth month, day dinghai: Great White was seen in daylight, lasting more than thirty days accumulated.

value.zh: 以晷度推之，非秦、魏，則楚也。
value.en: By gnomon reckoning the omen fell not on Qin or Wei but on Chu.
value.literal: Calculating by gnomon and degree, if not Qin or Wei, then it is Chu.

value.zh: 是時諸葛亮據渭南，司馬懿與相持。
value.en: Zhuge Liang held the south Wei River while Sima Yi locked horns with him.
value.literal: At that time Zhuge Liang held the south bank of the Wei River; Sima Yi faced him in stalemate.

value.zh: 孫權寇合肥，又遣陸議、孫韶等入淮、沔，帝親東征。
value.en: Sun Quan attacked Hefei and sent Lu Xun, Sun Shao, and others against the Huai and Han; the emperor marched east in person.
value.literal: Sun Quan raided Hefei; he also sent Lu Yi, Sun Shao, and others into the Huai and Han rivers; the emperor personally campaigned east.

value.zh: 蜀本秦地，則為秦、晉及楚兵悉起應占。
value.en: Shu lay in the old Qin domain, and armies of Qin, Jin, and Chu all took the field in fulfillment of the omen.
value.literal: Shu is originally Qin territory; thus the armies of Qin, Jin, and Chu all rose, answering the prognostication.

value.zh: 青龍二年七月己巳，月犯楗閉。
value.en: Qinglong 2, seventh month, day jisi: the moon crossed Door Bolt.
value.literal: Qinglong year 2, seventh month, day jisi: the moon encroached on Door Bolt.

value.zh: 占曰：「天子崩，又為火災。」
value.en: Prognostication reads: "The emperor dies; fire disaster follows."
value.literal: Prognostication says: "The Son of Heaven dies; moreover there is fire disaster."

value.zh: 三年七月，崇華殿災。
value.en: Qinglong 3, seventh month: Chonghua Palace burned.
value.literal: Year 3, seventh month, the Chonghua Palace suffered fire.

value.zh: 景初三年正月，明帝崩。
value.en: Jingchu 3, first month: Emperor Ming died.
value.literal: Jingchu year 3, first month, Emperor Ming died.

value.zh: 青龍二年十月戊寅，月犯太白。
value.en: Qinglong 2, tenth month, day wuyin: the moon crossed Venus.
value.literal: Qinglong year 2, tenth month, day wuyin: the moon encroached on Great White.

value.zh: 占曰：「人君死，又為兵。」
value.en: Prognostication reads: "The ruler dies; war follows."
value.literal: Prognostication says: "The ruler dies; moreover there is warfare."

value.zh: 景初元年七月，公孫淵叛。
value.en: Jingchu 1, seventh month: Gongsun Yuan rebelled.
value.literal: Jingchu year 1, seventh month, Gongsun Yuan rebelled.

value.zh: 二年正月，遣司馬懿討之。
value.en: Jingchu 2, first month: Sima Yi was dispatched to suppress him.
value.literal: Year 2, first month, Sima Yi was sent to attack him.

value.zh: 三年正月，明帝崩。
value.en: Jingchu 3, first month: Emperor Ming died.
value.literal: Year 3, first month, Emperor Ming died.

value.zh: 魏明帝青龍三年六月丁未，鎮星犯井鉞。
value.en: Wei Emperor Ming, Qinglong 3, sixth month, day dingwei: Saturn crossed Well Axe.
value.literal: Wei Emperor Ming, Qinglong year 3, sixth month, day dingwei: Quelling Star encroached on Well Axe.

value.zh: 四年閏四月乙巳，復犯。
value.en: Qinglong 4, intercalary fourth month, day yisi: it crossed again.
value.literal: Year 4, intercalary fourth month, day yisi: again encroached.

value.zh: 戊戌，太白又犯。
value.en: Day wuxu: Venus crossed it again.
value.literal: Day wuxu, Great White again encroached.

value.zh: 占曰：「凡月五星犯井鉞，悉為兵起。」
value.en: Prognostication reads: "Whenever the moon or planets cross Well Axe, war erupts."
value.literal: Prognostication says: "Whenever the moon or five planets encroach on Well Axe, all signify warfare rising."

value.zh: 一曰：「斧鉞用，大臣誅。」
value.en: Another reading: "The axes are drawn; great ministers are put to death."
value.literal: Another reading says: "Axe and halberd are deployed; great ministers are executed."

value.zh: 景初元年，公孫淵叛，司馬懿討滅之。
value.en: In Jingchu 1 Gongsun Yuan rebelled and Sima Yi crushed him.
value.literal: Jingchu year 1, Gongsun Yuan rebelled; Sima Yi attacked and destroyed him.

value.zh: 青龍三年七月己丑，鎮星犯東井。
value.en: Qinglong 3, seventh month, day jichou: Saturn crossed Eastern Well.
value.literal: Qinglong year 3, seventh month, day jichou: Quelling Star encroached on Eastern Well.

value.zh: 四年三月癸卯，在參，又還犯之。
value.en: Qinglong 4, third month, day guimao: while in Three Stars it swung back and crossed again.
value.literal: Year 4, third month, day guimao: in Three Stars, again returned and encroached on it.

value.zh: 占曰：「鎮星入井，大人憂。
value.en: Prognostication reads: "When Saturn enters the Well, exalted persons face disaster.
value.literal: Prognostication says: "When Quelling Star enters the Well, great persons have anxiety.

value.zh: 行近距為行陰，其占大水，五穀不成。」
value.en: Drawing near is called traveling in yin, portending great floods and failed harvests."
value.literal: Traveling near and close is traveling yin; its prognostication is great flood, the five grains do not ripen."

value.zh: 景初元年夏，大水，傷五穀。
value.en: Jingchu 1 summer brought catastrophic floods that ruined the crops.
value.literal: Jingchu year 1 summer, great flood, damaging the five grains.

value.zh: 九月，皇后毛氏崩。
value.en: In the ninth month Empress Mao died.
value.literal: Ninth month, Empress Mao died.

value.zh: 三年正月，明帝崩。
value.en: Jingchu 3, first month: Emperor Ming died.
value.literal: Year 3, first month, Emperor Ming died.

value.zh: 青龍三年十月壬申，太白晝見在尾，曆二百餘日恆見。
value.en: Qinglong 3, tenth month, day renshen: Venus appeared by day in Tail and remained visible for more than two hundred days.
value.literal: Qinglong year 3, tenth month, day renshen: Great White was seen in daylight in Tail, passing more than two hundred days constantly visible.

value.zh: 占曰：「尾為燕，燕臣強，有兵。」
value.en: Prognostication reads: "Tail corresponds to Yan—Yan's ministers grow strong and war follows."
value.literal: Prognostication says: "Tail is Yan; Yan's ministers are strong; there is warfare."

value.zh: 青龍四年三月己巳，太白與月俱加丙，晝見。
value.en: Qinglong 4, third month, day jisi: Venus and the moon both reached the bing quadrant and shone by day.
value.literal: Qinglong year 4, third month, day jisi: Great White and the moon together reached bing, seen in daylight.

value.zh: 月犯太白。
value.en: The moon crossed Venus.
value.literal: The moon encroached on Great White.

value.zh: 景初元年七月辛卯，太白又晝見，積二百八十餘日。
value.en: Jingchu 1, seventh month, day xinmao: Venus again appeared by day for more than 280 days.
value.literal: Jingchu year 1, seventh month, day xinmao: Great White was again seen in daylight, accumulating more than 280 days.

value.zh: 占悉同上。
value.en: The prognostications matched those above.
value.literal: All prognostications were the same as above.

value.zh: 是時公孫淵自立為燕王，署置百官，發兵距守，遣司馬懿討滅之。
value.en: Gongsun Yuan had declared himself King of Yan, installed a full court, and mobilized for defense until Sima Yi was sent and destroyed him.
value.literal: At that time Gongsun Yuan declared himself King of Yan, appointed the hundred officials, raised troops to hold out in defense; Sima Yi was sent to attack and destroy him.

value.zh: 青龍三年十二月戊辰，月犯鉤鈐。
value.en: Qinglong 3, twelfth month, day wuchen: the moon crossed Hooked Halberd.
value.literal: Qinglong year 3, twelfth month, day wuchen: the moon encroached on Hooked Halberd.

value.zh: 占曰：「王者憂。」
value.en: Prognostication reads: "The ruler faces disaster."
value.literal: Prognostication says: "The king has anxiety."

value.zh: 景初三年正月，明帝崩。
value.en: Jingchu 3, first month: Emperor Ming died.
value.literal: Jingchu year 3, first month, Emperor Ming died.

value.zh: 景初二年二月癸丑，月犯心距星，又犯中央大星。
value.en: Jingchu 2, second month, day guichou: the moon crossed Heart's margin star and then crossed its central great star.
value.literal: Jingchu year 2, second month, day guichou: the moon encroached on Heart's margin star, and again encroached on the central great star.

value.zh: 五月己亥，又犯心距星及中央大星。
value.en: Fifth month, day jihai: it crossed Heart's margin star and central great star again.
value.literal: Fifth month, day jihai, again encroached on Heart's margin star and the central great star.

value.zh: 閏月癸丑，月又犯心、中央大星。
value.en: Intercalary month, day guichou: the moon again crossed Heart and its central great star.
value.literal: Intercalary month, day guichou, the moon again encroached on Heart and the central great star.

value.zh: 按占，「大星為天王，前為太子，後為皇子。
value.en: Per the prognostications: "The central star is the celestial king; the star in front is the crown prince; the star behind is an imperial son.
value.literal: Checking the prognostications: "The great star is the celestial king; the star before it is the heir apparent; the star behind is a prince.

value.zh: 犯大星，王者惡之。
value.en: Crossing the great star—rulers dread it.
value.literal: Encroaching on the great star—rulers dread it.

value.zh: 犯前星，太子有憂。
value.en: Crossing the front star—the crown prince faces danger.
value.literal: Encroaching on the front star—the heir apparent has anxiety.

value.zh: 犯後星，庶子有憂。」
value.en: Crossing the rear star—imperial sons face danger."
value.literal: Encroaching on the rear star—lesser sons have anxiety."

value.zh: 三年正月，帝崩，太子立，卒見廢為齊王。
value.en: Jingchu 3, first month: the emperor died and the crown prince took the throne, only to be deposed as Prince of Qi.
value.literal: Year 3, first month, the emperor died; the heir apparent was enthroned, but in the end was deposed as Prince of Qi.

value.zh: 正始四年，秦王詢薨。
value.en: Zhengshi 4: Prince of Qin Xun died.
value.literal: Zhengshi year 4, Prince of Qin Xun died.

value.zh: 景初二年八月彗星見張，長三尺，逆西行，四十一日滅。
value.en: Jingchu 2, eighth month: a comet appeared in Extended Net, three feet long, moving retrograde westward; it faded after forty-one days.
value.literal: Jingchu year 2, eighth month: a comet appeared in Extended Net, three chi long, traveling west against the stars, extinguished after forty-one days.

value.zh: 占曰：「為兵喪。
value.en: Prognostication reads: "War and mourning follow.
value.literal: Prognostication says: "It presages warfare and mourning.

value.zh: 張，周分野，洛邑惡之。」
value.en: Extended Net marks Zhou's domain—Luoyang bears the omen."
value.literal: Extended Net is Zhou's allotted field—Luoyang is imperiled."

value.zh: 其十月，斬公孫淵。
value.en: That tenth month Gongsun Yuan was executed.
value.literal: That tenth month, Gongsun Yuan was beheaded.

value.zh: 明年正月，明帝崩。
value.en: The following first month Emperor Ming died.
value.literal: The next year, first month, Emperor Ming died.

value.zh: 景初二年十月甲午，月犯箕。
value.en: Jingchu 2, tenth month, day jiawu: the moon crossed Winnowing Basket.
value.literal: Jingchu year 2, tenth month, day jiawu: the moon encroached on Winnowing Basket.

value.zh: 占曰：「軍將死。」
value.en: Prognostication reads: "An army commander will die."
value.literal: Prognostication says: "Army generals die."

value.zh: 正始元年四月，車騎將軍黃權薨。
value.en: Zhengshi 1, fourth month: General of Chariots and Cavalry Huang Quan died.
value.literal: Zhengshi year 1, fourth month, General of Chariots and Cavalry Huang Quan died.

value.zh: 景初二年，司馬懿圍公孫淵于襄平。
value.en: Jingchu 2: Sima Yi besieged Gongsun Yuan at Xiangping.
value.literal: Jingchu year 2, Sima Yi besieged Gongsun Yuan at Xiangping.

value.zh: 八月丙寅夜，有大流星長數十丈，色白有芒鬣，從首山北流墜襄平城東南。
value.en: On the night of the eighth month's day bingyin a great meteor tens of fathoms long—white, with blazing rays—swept north from Mount Shou and fell southeast of Xiangping.
value.literal: Eighth month, day bingyin, night: there was a great meteor tens of zhang long, white with horned rays, flowing north from Shoushan and falling southeast of Xiangping city.

value.zh: 占曰：「圍城而有流星來走城上及墜城中者破。」
value.en: Prognostication reads: "When a city is under siege, a meteor racing over its walls or falling inside means the city will fall."
value.literal: Prognostication says: "When a city is besieged, if a meteor comes running over the wall or falls within the city, the city is broken."

value.zh: 又曰：「星墜，當其下有戰場。」
value.en: Also: "Where a star falls, a battlefield lies below."
value.literal: It also says: "When a star falls, beneath it there will be a battlefield."

value.zh: 又曰：「凡星所墜，國易姓。」
value.en: Also: "Wherever a star falls, a dynasty changes hands."
value.literal: It also says: "Whenever a star falls, the state's surname is changed."

value.zh: 九月，淵突圍，走至星墜所被斬，屠城坑其眾。
value.en: In the ninth month Yuan broke out, fled to the place where the star had fallen, and was killed; the city was sacked and its people put to the sword and buried in mass graves.
value.literal: Ninth month, Yuan broke the siege and fled to where the star had fallen, where he was beheaded; the city was slaughtered and its people buried alive in pits.

value.zh: 景初二年十月癸巳，客星見危，逆行在離宮北，騰蛇南。
value.en: Jingchu 2, tenth month, day guisi: a guest star appeared in Rooftop, moving retrograde between Retirement Palace to the north and Coiled Serpent to the south.
value.literal: Jingchu year 2, tenth month, day guisi: a guest star appeared in Rooftop, moving retrograde north of Retirement Palace, south of Coiled Serpent.

value.zh: 甲辰，犯宗星。
value.en: Day jiachen: it crossed the Ancestor star.
value.literal: Day jiachen, it encroached on the Ancestor star.

value.zh: 己酉，滅。
value.en: Day jiyou: it vanished.
value.literal: Day jiyou, it was extinguished.

value.zh: 占曰：「客星所出有兵喪。
value.en: Prognostication reads: "Where a guest star appears, war and mourning follow.
value.literal: Prognostication says: "Where a guest star appears, there is warfare and mourning.

value.zh: 虛危為宗廟，又為墳墓。
value.en: Emptiness and Rooftop govern the ancestral temple—and also tombs.
value.literal: Emptiness and Rooftop are the ancestral temple; they also signify graves.

value.zh: 客星近離宮，則宮中將有大喪，就先君於宗廟，皆王者崩殞之象也。」
value.en: A guest star near Retirement Palace foretells great mourning within the palace and rites for departed sovereigns at the ancestral temple—all omens of royal death."
value.literal: A guest star near Retirement Palace means the palace will soon have great mourning, paying respects to former rulers at the ancestral temple—all signs of a king's death."

value.zh: 三年正月，明帝崩。
value.en: Jingchu 3, first month: Emperor Ming died.
value.literal: Year 3, first month, Emperor Ming died.

value.zh: 正始二年五月，吳將硃然圍樊城，司馬懿率眾距卻之。
value.en: Zhengshi 2, fifth month: Wu general Zhu Ran besieged Fancheng; Sima Yi led an army and repulsed him.
value.literal: Zhengshi year 2, fifth month, Wu general Zhu Ran besieged Fancheng; Sima Yi led troops to repel and drive him back.

value.zh: 正始九年七月癸丑，鎮星犯楗閉。
value.en: Zhengshi 9, seventh month, day guichou: Saturn crossed Door Bolt.
value.literal: Zhengshi year 9, seventh month, day guichou: Quelling Star encroached on Door Bolt.

value.zh: 占曰：「王者不宜出宮下殿。」
value.en: Prognostication reads: "The sovereign should not leave the palace or step down from the throne hall."
value.literal: Prognostication says: "The king ought not leave the palace or descend from the hall."

value.zh: 明年，車駕謁陵，司馬懿奏誅曹爽等，天子野宿，於是失勢。
value.en: The next year the emperor went to pay respects at the tombs; Sima Yi moved to execute Cao Shuang and his faction; the emperor camped in the open—and from that moment lost all real power.
value.literal: The next year, the imperial carriage visited the tombs; Sima Yi memorialized to execute Cao Shuang and others; the Son of Heaven lodged in the open wilds, and thus lost power.

value.zh: 魏齊王正始元年四月戊午，月犯昴東頭第一星。
value.en: Under Wei emperor Cao Fang, Zhengshi 1, fourth month, day wuwu: the moon crossed the first star at the eastern horn of Hairy Head.
value.literal: Wei, Prince of Qi, Zhengshi year 1, fourth month, day wuwu: the moon encroached on the first star at the eastern end of Hairy Head.

value.zh: 其年十月庚寅，月又犯昴北頭第四星。
value.en: That year, tenth month, day gengyin: the moon again crossed the fourth star at the northern horn of Hairy Head.
value.literal: That year, tenth month, day gengyin: the moon again encroached on the fourth star at the northern end of Hairy Head.

value.zh: 占曰：「犯昴，胡不安。」
value.en: Prognostication reads: "Striking Hairy Head foretells unrest among the northern peoples".
value.literal: Prognostication says: "Encroaching on Hairy Head means the northern tribes are unsettled".

value.zh: 二年六月，鮮卑阿妙兒等寇西方，燉煌太守王延斬之，并二千餘級。
value.en: In the sixth month of year two the Xianbei under Amiao'er raided the west; Dunhuang administrator Wang Yan killed them, taking more than two thousand heads.
value.literal: " Year 2, sixth month: the Xianbei led by Amiao'er and others raided the west; Wang Yan, Administrator of Dunhuang, beheaded them, more than two thousand heads in all.

value.zh: 三年，又斬鮮卑大帥及千餘級。
value.en: In year three another Xianbei chieftain was killed, with more than a thousand heads taken.
value.literal: Year 3: the Xianbei great chief was again beheaded, with more than a thousand heads.

value.zh: 正始元年十月乙酉，彗星見西方，在尾，長三丈，拂牽牛，犯太白。
value.en: Zhengshi 1, tenth month, day yiyou: a comet appeared in the west at Tail, three zhang long, sweeping Lead Ox and crossing Venus.
value.literal: Zhengshi year 1, tenth month, day yiyou: a comet appeared in the west, in Tail, three zhang long, brushing Lead Ox and encroaching on Great White.

value.zh: 十一月甲子，進犯羽林。
value.en: Eleventh month, day jiazi: it advanced to strike Feathered Forest.
value.literal: Eleventh month, day jiazi: it advanced to encroach on Feathered Forest.

value.zh: 占曰：「尾為燕，又為吳，牛亦吳、越之分。
value.en: Prognostication reads: "Tail governs Yan and also Wu; Lead Ox marks Wu and Yue as well.
value.literal: Prognostication says: "Tail governs Yan and also Wu; Ox is likewise the allotted field of Wu and Yue.

value.zh: 太白為上將，羽林中軍兵。
value.en: Venus is the commander-in-chief; Feathered Forest is the central host.
value.literal: Great White is the great general; Feathered Forest is the central army.

value.zh: 吳、越有兵喪，中軍兵動。」
value.en: Wu and Yue face war and mourning; the central army mobilizes."
value.literal: Wu and Yue have warfare and mourning; the central army stirs."

value.zh: 二年五月，吳將全琮寇芍陂，朱然圍樊城，諸葛瑾入沮中。
value.en: In the fifth month of year two Wu general Quan Cong attacked Quebei; Zhu Ran besieged Fancheng; and Zhuge Jin entered Juzhong.
value.literal: " Year 2, fifth month: Wu general Quan Cong raided Quebei; Zhu Ran besieged Fancheng; Zhuge Jin entered Juzhong.

value.zh: 吳太子登卒。
value.en: Wu crown prince Deng died.
value.literal: Wu heir apparent Deng died.

value.zh: 六月，司馬懿討諸葛恪於皖，恪焚積聚，棄城走。
value.en: In the sixth month Sima Yi attacked Zhuge Ke at Wan; Ke burned his supplies and fled the city.
value.literal: Sixth month: Sima Yi attacked Zhuge Ke at Wan; Ke burned his stores and abandoned the city in flight.

value.zh: 三年，太尉滿寵薨。
value.en: In year three Grand Commandant Man Chong died.
value.literal: Year 3: Grand Commandant Man Chong died.

value.zh: 太和六年十一月丙寅，太白晝見南斗，遂歷八十餘日恒見。
value.en: Taihe 6, eleventh month, day bingyin: Venus appeared in daylight at Southern Dipper and stayed visible for more than eighty days.
value.literal: Taihe year 6, eleventh month, day bingyin: Great White was seen in daylight at Southern Dipper and remained constantly visible for more than eighty days.

value.zh: 占曰：「吳有兵。」
value.en: Prognostication reads: "Wu will see war".
value.literal: Prognostication says: "Wu has warfare".

value.zh: 明年，孫權遣張彌等將兵萬人，錫授公孫淵為燕王。
value.en: The next year Sun Quan sent Zhang Mi and others with ten thousand men to enfeoff Gongsun Yuan as King of Yan.
value.literal: " The next year Sun Quan sent Zhang Mi and others with ten thousand troops to invest Gongsun Yuan as King of Yan.

value.zh: 淵斬彌等，虜其眾。
value.en: Yuan killed Mi and his party and seized their troops.
value.literal: Yuan beheaded Mi and the others and captured their forces.

value.zh: 太和六年十一月丙寅，有星孛于翼，近太微上將星。
value.en: Taihe 6, eleventh month, day bingyin: a comet appeared at Wings, near the General-in-Chief star of Supreme Subtlety.
value.literal: Taihe year 6, eleventh month, day bingyin: a broom star appeared at Wings, near Supreme Subtlety's General-in-Chief star.

value.zh: 占曰：「為兵喪。」
value.en: Prognostication reads: "War and mourning follow".
value.literal: Prognostication says: "It presages warfare and mourning".

value.zh: 甘氏曰：「孛彗所當之國，是受其殃。」
value.en: Master Gan says: "The state a comet strikes receives its calamity".
value.literal: " Master Gan says: "The state struck by a broom or comet receives its calamity.

value.zh: 翼又楚分，孫權封略也。
value.en: Wings also marks Chu—Sun Quan's domain.
value.literal: " Wings is also Chu's allotted field—Sun Quan's territorial domain.

value.zh: 明年，權有遼東之敗。
value.en: The next year Quan met defeat in Liaodong.
value.literal: The next year Quan suffered defeat in Liaodong.

value.zh: 權又自向合肥新城，遣全琮征六安，皆不克而還。
value.en: Quan also marched on Hefei New City in person and sent Quan Cong against Lu'an; both failed and withdrew.
value.literal: Quan also advanced in person toward Hefei New City and sent Quan Cong to campaign against Lu'an; neither succeeded and both returned.

value.zh: 又明年，諸葛亮入秦川，據渭南，司馬懿距之。
value.en: The following year Zhuge Liang entered Qinchuan, held the south Wei River, and Sima Yi opposed him.
value.literal: The year after that Zhuge Liang entered Qinchuan, held the south bank of the Wei River, and Sima Yi opposed him.

value.zh: 孫權遣陸議、諸葛瑾等屯江夏口，孫韶、張承等向廣陵淮陽，權以大眾圍新城以應亮。
value.en: Sun Quan sent Lu Xun, Zhuge Jin, and others to hold Jiangxia Ford; Sun Shao, Zhang Cheng, and others toward Guangling and Huaiyang; and Quan himself besieged New City in support of Liang.
value.literal: Sun Quan sent Lu Yi, Zhuge Jin, and others to encamp at Jiangxia Ford; Sun Shao, Zhang Cheng, and others advanced toward Guangling and Huaiyang; Quan with a great host besieged New City to support Liang.

value.zh: 於是帝自東征，權及諸將乃退。
value.en: The emperor then marched east in person, and Quan and his commanders withdrew.
value.literal: Thereupon the emperor campaigned east in person, and Quan and his generals withdrew.

value.zh: 太和六年十二月，陳王植薨。
value.en: Taihe 6, twelfth month: Prince of Chen Zhi died.
value.literal: Taihe year 6, twelfth month: Prince of Chen Zhi died.

value.zh: 青龍元年夏，北海王蕤薨。
value.en: Qinglong 1, summer: Prince of Beihai Rui died.
value.literal: Qinglong year 1, summer: Prince of Beihai Rui died.

value.zh: 三年正月，太后郭氏崩。
value.en: Qinglong 3, first month: Empress Dowager Guo died.
value.literal: Year 3, first month: Empress Dowager Guo died.

value.zh: 正始四年十月、十一月，月再犯井鉞。
value.en: Zhengshi 4, tenth and eleventh months: the moon twice crossed Well's Halberd.
value.literal: Zhengshi year 4, tenth and eleventh months: the moon twice encroached on Well's Halberd.

value.zh: 是月，司馬懿討諸葛恪，恪棄城走。
value.en: That month Sima Yi attacked Zhuge Ke, who abandoned the city and fled.
value.literal: That month Sima Yi attacked Zhuge Ke; Ke abandoned the city and fled.

value.zh: 五年三月，曹爽征蜀。
value.en: Zhengshi 5, third month: Cao Shuang marched against Shu.
value.literal: Year 5, third month: Cao Shuang campaigned against Shu.

value.zh: 正始五年十一月癸巳，鎮星犯亢距星。
value.en: Zhengshi 5, eleventh month, day guisi: Saturn crossed the margin star of Neck.
value.literal: Zhengshi year 5, eleventh month, day guisi: Quelling Star encroached on the margin star of Neck.

value.zh: 占曰：「諸侯有失國者。」
value.en: Prognostication reads: "Some feudal lords will lose their states".
value.literal: Prognostication says: "Among the feudal lords there are those who lose their states".

value.zh: 嘉平元年，曹爽兄弟誅。
value.en: In Jiaping 1 Cao Shuang and his brothers were executed.
value.literal: " Jiaping year 1: Cao Shuang and his brothers were executed.

value.zh: 正始六年八月戊午，彗星見七星，長二尺，色白，進至張，積二十三日滅。
value.en: Zhengshi 6, eighth month, day wuwu: a white comet two chi long appeared at Seven Stars, advanced to Spread, and vanished after twenty-three days.
value.literal: Zhengshi year 6, eighth month, day wuwu: a comet appeared at Seven Stars, two chi long, white, advancing to Spread; it lasted twenty-three days and vanished.

value.zh: 七年十一月癸亥，又見軫，長一尺，積百五十六日滅。
value.en: In the seventh year, in the eleventh month, on guihai day, another comet one chi long appeared at Chariot Shaft and lasted one hundred fifty-six days.
value.literal: In the seventh year, in the eleventh month, on guihai day, it again appeared at Chariot Shaft, one chi long, lasting one hundred fifty-six days before vanishing.

value.zh: 九年三月，又見昴，長六尺，色青白，芒西南指。
value.en: In the ninth year, in the third month, another comet six chi long, greenish-white, appeared at Hairy Head with rays pointing southwest.
value.literal: In the ninth year, in the third month, it again appeared at Hairy Head, six chi long, greenish-white, its rays pointing southwest.

value.zh: 七月，又見翼，長二尺，進至軫，積四十二日滅。
value.en: Seventh month: another comet two chi long appeared at Wings, advanced to Chariot Shaft, and vanished after forty-two days.
value.literal: Seventh month: it again appeared at Wings, two chi long, advancing to Chariot Shaft; it lasted forty-two days and vanished.

value.zh: 按占，「七星、張，周分野，翼、軫為楚，昴為趙、魏，彗所以除舊布新，主兵喪也。」
value.en: Per the texts: "Seven Stars and Spread mark Zhou; Wings and Chariot Shaft mark Chu; Hairy Head marks Zhao and Wei; comets remove the old and spread the new and preside over war and mourning".
value.literal: Examining prognostication: "Seven Stars and Spread are Zhou's allotted field; Wings and Chariot Shaft are Chu; Hairy Head is Zhao and Wei; comets remove the old and spread the new and govern warfare and mourning".

value.zh: 嘉平元年，司馬懿誅曹爽兄弟及其黨與，皆夷族，京師嚴兵，實始翦魏。
value.en: In Jiaping 1 Sima Yi executed Cao Shuang, his brothers, and their faction, destroying their clans; the capital mobilized—Wei was truly cut back from that moment.
value.literal: " Jiaping year 1: Sima Yi executed Cao Shuang, his brothers, and their faction, exterminating their clans; the capital tightened its guard—this was the true beginning of pruning Wei.

value.zh: 三年，誅楚王彪，又襲王淩於淮南。
value.en: In year three Prince of Chu Biao was executed and Wang Ling was struck at Huainan.
value.literal: Year 3: Prince of Chu Biao was executed, and Wang Ling was attacked at Huainan.

value.zh: 淮南，東楚也。
value.en: Huainan is eastern Chu.
value.literal: Huainan is eastern Chu.

value.zh: 幽魏諸王于鄴。
value.en: Wei princes were confined at Ye.
value.literal: The princes of Wei were confined at Ye.

value.zh: 正始七年七月丁丑，月犯左角。
value.en: Zhengshi 7, seventh month, day dingchou: the moon crossed Left Horn.
value.literal: Zhengshi year 7, seventh month, day dingchou: the moon encroached on Left Horn.

value.zh: 占曰：「天下有兵，將軍死。」
value.en: Prognostication reads: "War will break out and a general will die".
value.literal: Prognostication says: "Under Heaven there is warfare; a general dies".

value.zh: 九年正月辛亥，月犯亢南星。
value.en: In the ninth year, in the first month, on xinhai day, the moon crossed the southern star of Neck.
value.literal: In the ninth year, in the first month, on xinhai day, the moon encroached on the southern star of Neck.

value.zh: 占曰：「兵起。」
value.en: Prognostication reads: "Arms will be raised".
value.literal: Prognostication says: "Warfare rises".

value.zh: 一曰：「軍將死。」
value.en: Alternatively: "An army commander will die".
value.literal: " One reading says: "An army commander dies.

value.zh: 七月乙亥，熒惑犯畢距星。
value.en: Seventh month, day yihai: Mars crossed the margin star of Net.
value.literal: " Seventh month, day yihai: Sparkling Deluder encroached on the margin star of Net.

value.zh: 占曰：「有邊兵。」
value.en: Prognostication reads: "Frontier war will erupt".
value.literal: Prognostication says: "There is warfare on the frontier".

value.zh: 一曰：「刑罰用。」
value.en: Alternatively: "Punishments will be enforced".
value.literal: " One reading says: "Punishments are applied.

value.zh: 嘉平元年，曹爽等誅。
value.en: In Jiaping 1 Cao Shuang and his faction were executed.
value.literal: " Jiaping year 1: Cao Shuang and others were executed.

value.zh: 三年，王淩等又誅。
value.en: In year three Wang Ling and his associates were executed again.
value.literal: Year 3: Wang Ling and others were again executed.

value.zh: 高熲，字昭玄，一名敏，自雲渤海蓚人也。
value.en: Gao Jiong, whose courtesy name was Zhaoxuan and who was also known as Min, was a native of the Bohai frontier district, by his own account.
value.literal: Gao Jiong — styled Zhaoxuan, also called Min, claimed by his own account to be from the Bohai border district of Zhuo.

value.zh: 父賓，背齊歸周，大司馬獨孤信引為僚佐，賜姓獨孤氏。
value.en: His father Bin had abandoned Northern Qi for Northern Zhou, where Grand Marshal Dugu Xin recruited him to his staff and bestowed the surname Dugu upon him.
value.literal: His father Bin turned against Qi and submitted to Zhou; Grand Marshal Dugu Xin took him on as a staff officer and granted him the surname Dugu.

value.zh: 及信被誅，妻子徙蜀。
value.en: After Xin was put to death, his family was sent into exile in Shu.
value.literal: When Xin was executed, his wife and children were banished to Shu.

value.zh: 文獻皇后以賓父之故吏，每往來其家。
value.en: Empress Wenxian — for Bin had once served under her father — was in the habit of visiting the Gao home.
value.literal: Empress Wenxian, because Bin had been a former subordinate of her father, often came and went at his household.

value.zh: 賓後官至鄀州刺史，及熲貴，贈禮部尚書、渤海公。
value.en: Bin eventually rose to governor of Ezhou; once Jiong came to power, he was posthumously enfeoffed as Minister of Rites and Duke of Bohai.
value.literal: Bin later reached the office of Governor of E Prefecture; when Jiong rose to eminence, Bin was posthumously made Minister of Rites and Duke of Bohai.

value.zh: 頃之，熲國令上熲陰事，稱：「其子表仁謂熲曰：'司馬仲達初托疾不朝，遂有天下。
value.en: Soon his estate steward denounced him, reporting, "His son Biaoren had said to him, 'Sima Yi feigned illness and stayed away from court — and in the end seized the realm.
value.literal: Before long Jiong's estate steward reported Jiong's secret affairs, saying: "His son Biaoren said to Jiong: 'Sima Yi at first feigned illness and did not attend court, and in the end possessed all under Heaven.

value.zh: 公今遇此，焉知非福！
value.en: You are in the same position now — who is to say this is not a blessing in disguise?'
value.literal: You now meet this — how do you know it is not fortune!'

value.zh: '」於是上大怒，囚熲于內史省而鞫之。
value.en: " The emperor was furious, imprisoned Jiong in the Ministry of the Interior, and put him on trial.
value.literal: " Thereupon the sovereign was greatly enraged, imprisoned Jiong in the Ministry of the Interior, and interrogated him.

value.zh: 憲司複奏熲他事，雲：「沙門真覺嘗謂熲雲：'明年國有大喪。
value.en: The prosecutors added further charges, saying, "The monk Zhenjue had told Jiong, 'Next year the state will mourn a great death.'
value.literal: The law officers again memorialized other matters concerning Jiong, saying: "The monk Zhenjue once told Jiong: 'Next year the state will have a great mourning.'

value.zh: '尼令暉複雲：'十七、十八年，皇帝有大厄。
value.en: The nun Linghui had also said, 'In the seventeenth and eighteenth years the emperor will face grave peril.
value.literal: 'The nun Linghui again said: 'In the seventeenth and eighteenth years the emperor will suffer a great calamity.

value.zh: 十九年不可過。
value.en: He will not survive the nineteenth year.'
value.literal: The nineteenth year cannot be passed.'

value.zh: '」上聞而益怒，顧謂群臣曰：「帝王豈可力求！
value.en: " The emperor, hearing this, turned to the court and exclaimed, "Does anyone think the throne can be seized by scheming!
value.literal: " The sovereign heard and grew ever angrier, turned to the assembled ministers and said, "Can an emperor's throne be striven for by force!

value.zh: 孔子以大聖之才，作法垂世，寧不欲大位邪？
value.en: Confucius, for all his sagehood, laid down laws for the ages — would he not have wanted the throne?
value.literal: Confucius, with the talent of the greatest sage, established law to last through the ages — would he not have desired the supreme position?

value.zh: 天命不可耳。
value.en: Only the Mandate of Heaven denied it to him.
value.literal: It was only that the Mandate of Heaven did not allow it.

value.zh: 熲與子言，自比晉帝，此何心乎？」
value.en: Jiong spoke to his son and likened himself to an emperor of Jin — what treason is this?"
value.literal: Jiong spoke with his son and compared himself to the Jin emperor — what sort of heart is this?"

value.zh: 有司請斬熲。
value.en: The judges asked that Jiong be executed.
value.literal: The relevant offices requested Jiong be beheaded.

value.zh: 上曰：「去年殺虞慶則，今茲斬王世積，如更誅熲，天下其謂我何？」
value.en: The emperor said, "Last year I killed Yu Qingze, this year Wang Shiji — if I kill Jiong as well, what will the world say of me?"
value.literal: The sovereign said: "Last year I killed Yu Qingze; this year I beheaded Wang Shiji — if I also execute Jiong, what will all under Heaven say of me?"

value.zh: 於是除名為民。
value.en: He was therefore stripped of rank and made a commoner.
value.literal: Thereupon he was stripped of name and made a commoner.

value.zh: 熲初為僕射，其母誡之曰：「汝富貴已極，但有一斫頭耳，爾宜慎之！」
value.en: When Jiong first became vice director, his mother warned him, "You have risen as high as a man can — only the executioner's blade remains; take care!"
value.literal: When Jiong first became Vice Director, his mother admonished him, saying: "Your wealth and honor have already reached the limit — there is only one thing left, a beheading — you should be careful!"

value.zh: 熲由是常恐禍變。
value.en: From that time he lived in constant fear of disaster.
value.literal: Jiong thereby constantly feared calamity and change.

value.zh: 及此，熲歡然無恨色，以為得免於禍。
value.en: Now he accepted his punishment without bitterness, believing he had escaped with his life.
value.literal: At this, Jiong was pleased and had no look of resentment, thinking he had escaped calamity.

value.zh: 司馬休之 司馬楚之 司馬景之 司馬叔璠 司馬天助
value.en: Sima Xiuzhi, Sima Chuzhi, Sima Jingzhi, Sima Shufan, and Sima Tianzhu
value.literal: Sima Xiuzhi, Sima Chuzhi, Sima Jingzhi, Sima Shufan, Sima Tianzhu

value.zh: 晉宣帝季弟譙王遜之後也 南本以下諸本及北史卷二九司馬休之傳「遜」作「進」。
value.en: "A descendant of Prince of Qiao Sima Xun": in the Southern edition and later editions, and in the Beishi biography of Sima Xiuzhi (juan 29), "Xun" is written as "Jin."
value.literal: "A descendant of Prince of Qiao Sima Xun": in the Southern edition and later editions, and in the Beishi biography of Sima Xiuzhi (juan 29), "Xun" is written as "Jin."

value.zh: 百衲本作「遜」，汲、局二本注宋本作「遜」。
value.en: The Patchwork edition reads "Xun"; the Ji and Bureau editions' notes on the Song edition also read "Xun."
value.literal: The Patchwork edition has "Xun"; the Ji and Bureau editions' notes on the Song edition also have "Xun."

value.zh: 錢氏考異卷二八、李慈銘魏書札記、張森楷魏書校勘記各有說。
value.en: Qian's Textual Variants (juan 28), Li Ciming's Notes on the Book of Wei, and Zhang Senkai's Collation of the Book of Wei each discuss the point.
value.literal: Qian's Textual Variants juan 28, Li Ciming's Notes on the Book of Wei, and Zhang Senkai's Collation of the Book of Wei each have explanations.

value.zh: 按晉書卷三七譙王遜傳，遜是進子，進死於曹魏時，封譙王的是遜，不是進。
value.en: According to the Jinshu biography of Prince of Qiao Sima Xun (juan 37), Xun was Jin's son. Jin died in the Cao-Wei period, and it was Xun who was enfeoffed as Prince of Qiao, not Jin.
value.literal: According to Jinshu juan 37 biography of Prince of Qiao Sima Xun, Xun was Jin's son; Jin died in Cao-Wei times, and the one enfeoffed as Prince of Qiao was Xun, not Jin.

value.zh: 但進才是晉宣帝司馬懿季弟，遜是從子，作「遜」也有問題。
value.en: Yet only Jin was the youngest brother of Jin's Emperor Xuan, Sima Yi; Xun was a nephew. Writing "Xun" is also problematic.
value.literal: But only Jin was the youngest brother of Jin's Emperor Xuan Sima Yi; Xun was a nephew—writing "Xun" also has problems.

value.zh: 作「進」作「遜」既都有問題，而宋本作「遜」，恐原來就錯。
value.en: Whether one writes "Jin" or "Xun" both are problematic, yet the Song edition reads "Xun"—the original text was probably already in error.
value.literal: Whether written "Jin" or "Xun" both have problems, yet the Song edition has "Xun"—probably the original was already wrong.

value.zh: 此卷史實上的謬誤較多，疑有訛脫竄亂，非魏收原文。
value.en: This chapter contains many factual errors and is suspected of corruption, omission, and interpolation—not Wei Shou's original text.
value.literal: This juan has rather many factual errors; it is suspected there are corruptions, omissions, and interpolations—not Wei Shou's original text.

value.zh: 漢紀五十九起閼逢敦牂，盡柔兆涒灘，凡三年。
value.en: Han Records 59 Spanning from the year Yanfeng Dunxiang through Rouzhao Toushan—a period of three years.
value.literal: Han Records 59 Beginning with Yanfeng Dunxiang, ending with Rouzhao Toushan, three years in all.

value.zh: 丞相主簿司馬懿言於操曰：「劉備以詐力虜劉璋，蜀人未附，而遠爭江陵，此機不可失也。
value.en: Chief Clerk Sima Yi said to Cao, "Liu Bei seized Liu Zhang by fraud and force; the people of Shu are not yet loyal to him, yet he is fighting far away at Jiangling—this is an opportunity we must not miss.
value.literal: Chief Clerk of the Chancellor Sima Yi spoke to Cao, saying: "Liu Bei by deceit and force captured Liu Zhang; the people of Shu are not yet attached, yet he contends far away at Jiangling—this opportunity must not be lost.

value.zh: 今克漢中，益州震動，進兵臨之，勢必瓦解。
value.en: With Hanzhong in our hands, Yizhou will be shaken; if we march against it at once, it will surely fall apart.
value.literal: Now that Hanzhong is taken, Yizhou will be shaken; if we advance and press upon it, the momentum will surely collapse.

value.zh: 聖人不能違時，亦不可失時也。」
value.en: Even a sage cannot defy the season, and one must not miss the moment."
value.literal: A sage cannot go against the times, nor can one miss the times."

value.zh: 操曰：「人苦無足，既得隴，復望蜀邪！」
value.en: Cao said, "Men are never satisfied—having taken Long, you would look to Shu as well!"
value.literal: Cao said: "Men suffer from lack of contentment—having already gained Long, yet still look to Shu!"

value.zh: 劉曄曰：「劉備，人傑也，有度而遲；
value.en: Liu Ye said, "Liu Bei is a man of heroic stature—far-sighted but deliberate;
value.literal: Liu Ye said: "Liu Bei is a hero among men—he has measure yet is slow;

value.zh: 得蜀日淺，蜀人未恃也。
value.en: he has held Shu only briefly, and the people there do not yet trust him.
value.literal: he has held Shu for only a short time, and the people of Shu do not yet rely on him.

value.zh: 今破漢中，蜀人震恐，其勢自傾。
value.en: With Hanzhong lost, the people of Shu are terrified and his position is already crumbling.
value.literal: Now that Hanzhong is broken, the people of Shu will be shaken in terror and their momentum will collapse of itself.

value.zh: 以公之神明，因其傾而壓之，無不克也。
value.en: With your brilliance, if you press him while he is faltering, you cannot fail.
value.literal: With your brilliance, if you press upon them as they collapse, there is nothing you cannot overcome.

value.zh: 若小緩之，諸葛亮明於治國而為相，關羽、張飛勇冠三軍而為將，蜀民既定，據險守要，則不可犯矣。
value.en: Wait even a little, and with Zhuge Liang as a brilliant administrator and chancellor and Guan Yu and Zhang Fei as the bravest generals in the land, once the people of Shu settle in and hold the mountain passes, he will become untouchable.
value.literal: If you relax slightly, Zhuge Liang is clear in governing the state and serves as chancellor; Guan Yu and Zhang Fei are bravest in the three armies and serve as generals; once the people of Shu are settled and hold difficult passes and guard strategic points, they cannot be violated.

value.zh: 今不取，必為後憂。」
value.en: If you do not strike now, you will regret it later."
value.literal: If you do not take it now, it will surely become a later worry."

value.zh: 操不從。
value.en: Cao would not listen.
value.literal: Cao did not follow his advice.

value.zh: 居七日，蜀降者說「蜀中一日數十驚，守將雖斬之而不能安也。」
value.en: Seven days later a defector from Shu reported, "In Shu there are dozens of alarms in a single day; though the garrison commanders execute people, they cannot restore order."
value.literal: After seven days, a Shu surrenderer said: "In Shu there are several tens of alarms in a single day; though the defending generals execute men, they cannot restore calm."

value.zh: 操問曄曰：「今尚可擊不？」
value.en: Cao asked Liu Ye, "Can we still attack?"
value.literal: Cao asked Ye: "Can we still attack now?"

value.zh: 曄曰：「今已小定，未可擊也。」
value.en: Liu Ye said, "It has already stabilized somewhat—we cannot attack now."
value.literal: Ye said: "It has now settled somewhat; it cannot be attacked."

value.zh: 乃還。
value.en: So Cao withdrew.
value.literal: He then returned.

value.zh: 以夏侯淵為都護將軍，督張郃、徐晃等守漢中；
value.en: He appointed Xiahou Yuan Protector General to command Zhang He, Xu Huang, and others in holding Hanzhong;
value.literal: He made Xiahou Yuan Protector General and had him supervise Zhang He, Xu Huang, and others in guarding Hanzhong;

value.zh: 以丞相長史杜襲為駙馬都尉，留督漢中事。
value.en: He left Chancellor Chief Clerk Du Xi as Commandant of Equipage to oversee civil affairs in Hanzhong.
value.literal: he made Chancellor Chief Clerk Du Xi Commandant of Equipage and left him to supervise Hanzhong affairs.

value.zh: 襲綏懷開導，百姓自樂出徙洛、鄴者八萬餘口。
value.en: Du Xi soothed and settled the people with gentle guidance, and more than eighty thousand families willingly migrated to Luoyang and Ye.
value.literal: Xi soothed and guided with kindness; more than eighty thousand common people willingly moved out to settle in Luoyang and Ye.

value.zh: 魏紀一
value.en: Wei Records 1
value.literal: Wei Records 1

value.zh: 是時太子在鄴，軍中騷動。
value.en: The Crown Prince was then at Ye, and the army was in uproar.
value.literal: At this time the Heir Apparent was at Ye, and the army was in turmoil.

value.zh: 群僚欲秘不發喪，諫議大夫賈逵以為事不可秘，乃發喪。
value.en: The ministers wished to conceal the death and not announce mourning, but Remonstrance Counselor Jia Kui argued that the affair could not be hidden, and mourning was proclaimed.
value.literal: The officials wished to keep secret and not announce the mourning. Remonstrance Counselor Jia Kui held that the matter could not be kept secret, and so the mourning was announced.

value.zh: 或言宜諸城守，悉用譙、沛人。
value.en: Some proposed that every city garrison should be staffed entirely with men from Qiao and Pei.
value.literal: Some said that city garrisons should all employ men from Qiao and Pei.

value.zh: 魏郡太守廣陵徐宣厲聲曰：「今者遠近一統，人懷效節，何必專任譙、沛以沮宿衛者之心！」
value.en: Xu Xuan of Guangling, prefect of Wei Commandery, said sharply: "Now that the realm is united from near and far, and all are eager to serve, why should we rely solely on men from Qiao and Pei and thus discourage the hearts of the palace guards!"
value.literal: Administrator of Wei Commandery Xu Xuan of Guangling said sternly: "Now near and far are united, and men are ready to serve faithfully—why must we exclusively employ those from Qiao and Pei to dampen the hearts of the long-serving guards!"

value.zh: 乃止。
value.en: The proposal was dropped.
value.literal: And so it was stopped.

value.zh: 青州兵擅擊鼓相引去，眾人以為宜禁止之，不從者討之。
value.en: Qingzhou troops began beating drums on their own and marched off together. Many thought they should be stopped by force and that anyone who refused should be attacked.
value.literal: Qingzhou soldiers on their own beat drums and led one another away. The crowd thought they should be stopped, and those who did not obey should be punished.

value.zh: 賈逵曰：「不可。」
value.en: Jia Kui said, "That must not be done."
value.literal: Jia Kui said: "It cannot be done."

value.zh: 為作長檄，令所在給其稟食。
value.en: He drafted a long proclamation ordering every locality along their route to furnish them rations.
value.literal: He wrote a long dispatch ordering that wherever they passed, provisions be supplied to them.

value.zh: 鄢陵侯彰從長安來赴，問逵先王璽綬所在，逵正色曰：「國有儲副，先王璽綬非君侯所宜問也。」
value.en: Marquis Zhang of Yanling had come from Chang'an to attend the funeral and asked Kui where the late king's seal and ribbon were. Kui said sternly, "The state already has an heir designate; the seal and ribbon of the late king are not a matter Your Lordship should raise."
value.literal: Marquis Zhang of Yanling came from Chang'an to attend and asked Kui where the late king's seal and cord were. Kui said with stern face: "The state has a designated heir; the late king's seal and cord are not what Your Lordship should inquire about."

value.zh: 凶問至鄴，太子號哭不已。
value.en: When word of the death reached Ye, the Crown Prince wailed ceaselessly.
value.literal: When news of the death reached Ye, the Heir Apparent wailed without cease.

value.zh: 中庶子司馬孚諫曰：「君王晏駕，天下恃殿下為命。
value.en: Palace Attendant Sima Fu admonished him: "Our lord is gone, and the empire looks to Your Highness for its very life.
value.literal: Palace Attendant Sima Fu remonstrated: "Our lord has passed away; the empire relies on Your Highness for its fate.

value.zh: 當上為宗廟，下為萬國，奈何效匹夫孝也！」
value.en: You must tend the ancestral shrines above and govern the myriad realms below—why imitate the mourning of a private commoner!"
value.literal: You should above serve the ancestral temple and below rule ten thousand states—why act the private filial piety of a common man!"

value.zh: 太子良久乃止，曰：「卿言是也。」
value.en: Only after a long while did the Crown Prince cease and say, "You speak rightly."
value.literal: After a long while the Heir Apparent stopped and said: "Your words are correct."

value.zh: 時群臣初聞王薨，相聚哭，無復行列。
value.en: When the ministers had first heard that the King was dead, they had clustered together in tears with no regard for order.
value.literal: At this time when the officials first heard the King had died, they gathered to weep and there was no longer any formation of ranks.

value.zh: 孚厲聲於朝曰：「今君王違世，天下震動，當早拜嗣君，以鎮萬國，而但哭邪！」
value.en: Fu cried out sternly in court: "Our lord has departed and the realm is shaken. You ought to bow to the successor at once to steady the empire—yet all you do is weep!"
value.literal: Fu said sternly in court: "Now our lord has left the world and the empire trembles—we should early pay homage to the successor to settle ten thousand states—yet only weep?"

value.zh: 乃罷群臣，備禁衛，治喪事。
value.en: He then dismissed the assembly, posted the guards, and set the mourning in order.
value.literal: Then he dismissed the officials, prepared the guard, and arranged mourning affairs.

value.zh: 孚，懿之弟也。
value.en: Fu was the younger brother of Sima Yi.
value.literal: Fu was Sima Yi's younger brother.

value.zh: 群臣以為太子即位，當須詔命。
value.en: The ministers held that the Crown Prince could not take the throne without an imperial edict.
value.literal: The officials thought that for the Heir Apparent to ascend, an imperial edict was required.

value.zh: 尚書陳矯曰：「王薨於外，天下惶懼。
value.en: Minister of Works Chen Qiao said, "The King died away from the capital, and the realm is filled with fear.
value.literal: Minister Chen Qiao said: "The King died abroad; the empire is fearful and alarmed.

value.zh: 太子宜割哀即位，以系遠近之望。
value.en: The Crown Prince ought to set grief aside and take the throne at once, to hold the hopes of men near and far together.
value.literal: The Heir Apparent should cut short mourning and ascend, to tie the hopes of near and far.

value.zh: 且又愛子在側，彼此生變，則社稷危也。」
value.en: Moreover, with a favored son close at hand, any friction between them could put the altars of state in danger."
value.literal: Moreover there is a favored son at hand—if each side bred change, the altars of state would be in peril."

value.zh: 即具官備禮，一日皆辦。
value.en: The requisite officials and ceremonies were prepared that same day.
value.literal: Immediately the officials and rituals were all provided, completed in one day.

value.zh: 明旦，以王后令，策太子即王位，大赦。
value.en: The next morning, by order of the Queen, the Crown Prince was installed as King and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
value.literal: Next dawn, by the Queen's order, the Heir Apparent was enthroned as King with an edict of investiture, and a general amnesty was declared.

value.zh: 漢帝尋遣御史大夫華歆奉策詔，授太子丞相印、綬，魏王璽、綬，領冀州牧。
