value.en: Before long the Han emperor dispatched Imperial Counselor Hua Xin with the formal investiture, granting the Crown Prince the seals and ribbons of Chancellor and King of Wei and appointing him Governor of Ji Province.
value.literal: Soon the Han Emperor sent Imperial Counselor Hua Xin bearing the edict of investiture, conferring on the Heir Apparent the seal and cord of Chancellor, the seal and cord of King of Wei, and appointment as Governor of Ji Province.

value.zh: 於是尊王后曰王太后。
value.en: The Queen was then honored as Queen Dowager.
value.literal: Thereupon the Queen was honored as Queen Dowager.

value.zh: 魏紀三
value.en: Wei Records 3
value.literal: Wei Records 3

value.zh: 春，正月，司馬懿攻新城，旬有六日，拔之，斬孟達。
value.en: In spring, during the first month, Sima Yi besieged Xincheng; within sixteen days he captured it and executed Meng Da.
value.literal: Spring, first month, Sima Yi attacked Xincheng; in sixteen days he took it and beheaded Meng Da.

value.zh: 申儀久在魏興，擅承製刻印，多所假授；
value.en: Shen Yi had long served in Weixing, where he had taken it upon himself to cut seals and issue credentials on his own authority, handing out many illicit commissions.
value.literal: Shen Yi had long been in Weixing, usurping authority to engrave seals on imperial orders and granting many unauthorized appointments.

value.zh: 懿召而執之，歸于洛陽。
value.en: Sima Yi summoned him, placed him under arrest, and sent him back to Luoyang.
value.literal: Yi summoned and arrested him, then sent him back to Luoyang.

value.zh: 吳王使鄱陽太守周魴密求山中舊族名帥為北方所聞知者，令譎挑揚州牧曹休。
value.en: The King of Wu had Poyang Administrator Zhou Fang secretly recruit mountain clan leaders whose names were known in the north, to lure and provoke Yang Province Governor Cao Xiu.
value.literal: The King of Wu had Poyang Administrator Zhou Fang secretly seek out old clan leaders of renown in the mountains known to the north, and had them deceive and provoke Yang Province Governor Cao Xiu.

value.zh: 魴曰：「民帥小丑，不足杖任，事或漏洩，不能致休。
value.en: Fang said, "These local chiefs are small fry—not fit for the task; word might leak and we would fail to draw Xiu out.
value.literal: Fang said: "These civilian chieftains are petty figures, not fit to be relied upon; the affair might leak and fail to draw Xiu.

value.zh: 乞遣親人繼箋以誘休，言被譴懼誅，欲以郡降北，求兵應接。」
value.en: Send my kinsman Ji Jian to bait Xiu—say I have been censured and fear death, wish to surrender the commandery to Wei, and need troops to receive me."
value.literal: I beg to send a close kinsman, Ji Jian, to entice Xiu, saying that having been reprimanded and fearing execution, he wishes to surrender the commandery to the north and seeks troops to support him."

value.zh: 吳王許之。
value.en: The King of Wu agreed.
value.literal: The King of Wu consented.

value.zh: 時頻有郎官詣魴詰問諸事，魴因詣郡門下，下發謝。
value.en: Court envoys kept coming to question Fang; he went to the commandery gate and issued a letter of apology.
value.literal: At the time palace attendants frequently came to Fang to question him on various matters; Fang therefore went to the commandery gate, sent down a letter of apology.

value.zh: 休聞之，率步騎十萬向皖以應魴；
value.en: When Xiu heard, he led one hundred thousand foot and horse toward Wan to answer Fang.
value.literal: When Xiu heard of it, he led one hundred thousand infantry and cavalry toward Wan to answer Fang.

value.zh: 帝又使司馬懿向江陵，賈逵向東關，三道俱進。
value.en: The emperor also sent Sima Yi toward Jiangling and Jia Kui toward Dong Pass—the three columns advanced together.
value.literal: The Emperor also sent Sima Yi toward Jiangling and Jia Kui toward Dong Pass; all three columns advanced together.

value.zh: 大司馬曹真以「漢(蜀)人數入寇，請由斜谷伐之。
value.en: Grand Minister of War Cao Zhen said, "Han troops have repeatedly raided. I request to attack by way of Xiegu.
value.literal: Grand Minister of War Cao Zhen said, "Han troops have repeatedly raided; I request to attack them by way of Xiegu.

value.zh: 諸將數道並進，可以大克。」
value.en: With several generals advancing on parallel routes, a crushing victory could be won."
value.literal: If the generals advance on several routes together, a great victory can be achieved."
